question: 'Chhappar Mela' is held in which of the following state?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Punjab**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• **Chhappar Mela** is an annual festival held in the state of **Punjab**, India.
 
• This mela (fair) is organized in the village of **Chhappar**, located in the **Ludhiana district** of Punjab.
 
• The mela is celebrated in the month of **September**, coinciding with the auspicious day of **Anant Chaturdashi**.
 
• It is known for the worship of **snakes** and showcases local culture, traditions, and festivities.
 
• The mela attracts thousands of devotees and visitors, making it a significant eve
